gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 explicitly checks the advertised solution against the printed initial condition, shows the factor-of-two mismatch, identifies the true solution under the printed data, and gives the specific correction of the initial condition or exact solution.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both identify that the advertised function has initial trace 2 exp(-x·x), whereas the printed IVP specifies exp(-x·x), so the benchmark's stated problem and claimed exact solution are inconsistent.
